name: @wippy-session/wippy-form
title: Session Form
description: Renders one Session form and submits the answer back to the owning session: a choice-only form as a question card, a form with standard fields (text, textarea, number, email, date, checkbox, alone or mixed with choices) as one fields form.

wippy.description: Renders one Session form (from the `ask_user` or `ask_user_fields` tool) and sends the answer back to the owning session through the Host's artifact-state API. A form of choice questions only (form version 1) renders as a question card: each question supports per-answer notes and, when the definition allows it, an Other free-text row, and a form with several questions shows one at a time, with a counter and a review step before sending. A form with at least one standard field (form version 2: `text`, `textarea`, `number`, `email`, `date` or `checkbox`, alone or with choices) renders as a fields form: a labelled control for every field, each error tied to its control, and one Submit button. Once the answer is accepted, either becomes a read-only summary. The inputs are `definition` (the questions), `form-version` (1 and 2 render; a higher version, or a field type this version does not know, disables submission), and `state` (`active` while the form can be answered, `idle` after it was answered). The component loads and submits by itself, so the tag only needs these attributes. Agents must never write the `<wippy-form>` tag, because it is created only through the Session `ask_user` and `ask_user_fields` tools.

form-version.description: Form definition schema version: 1 is a choice-only form, 2 is a form with at least one standard field (`text`, `textarea`, `number`, `email`, `date`, `checkbox`). A higher value, from this prop or from the loaded state's own `form_version`, disables the interactive form and shows the notice "This form needs a newer version of the app." instead, and so does a field whose type this version does not know.

definition.description: The questions to ask: `title`, optional `description`, and `fields`. Every field is `{ id, type, label, description?, required }` plus the keys of its type: `choice` adds `options: [{value, label, description?}]`, `multiple` and `allow_other`; `text` and `textarea` add `min_length`, `max_length`, `placeholder` and `default` (`text` also `pattern`, a full-match expression that only the server checks, answering a mismatch with a 422 `pattern_mismatch` on the field); `number` adds `min`, `max`, `step`, `integer` and `default`; `email` adds `default`; `date` adds `min`, `max` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) and `default`; `checkbox` adds `default` (only `false`). Optional `submit_label` is the fields form's Submit button text (the question card does not show it), and optional `answered_message` is accepted and not shown. When every field is a choice the question card renders, otherwise the fields form. A definition with no fields shows an error message.

state.description: Package-tag lifecycle state mirrored from the artifact: "active" (still answerable) or "idle" (already answered, shown read-only). Changing this prop triggers a reload of the canonical form state from the Host.
